title: Gate No False-Green — Nonfeed Capability vs Feed Baseline Split
problem: F232 readiness emitted READY_TO_RUN_NOW but live output was 100% feed with QUALITY_FAIL_FEED_ONLY and nonfeed_evidence_missing=true. Feed baseline is acceptable but was incorrectly labeled as nonfeed capability readiness.
solution_summary: Split gate verdicts into capability vs feed baseline paths with explicit blocking reasons

new_verdicts.meaning: All nonfeed capability checks pass. Nonfeed evidence surface confirmed.
Feed baseline runnable. Nonfeed capability blocked by one or more conditions.

why_nonfeed_capability_blocked.description: Semicolon-separated reason(s) for capability block: provider_surface_degraded; canonical_fallback_detected; f232g_research_quality_missing

degraded_but_allowed.description: Provider surface degraded but explicitly allowed for this run type

canonical_fallback_detected.description: Canonical acquisition fallback schema detected in decision gate data

f233d_nonfeed_prelude_coverage.description: F233D nonfeed_prelude_coverage.json with coverage_present=true present (soft-fail if absent)

f232_context.f233f_gate_behavior: Would emit READY_FOR_FEED_BASELINE_ONLY instead of READY_TO_RUN_NOW

success_criteria: Gate no longer labels feed-only readiness as nonfeed capability readiness
abort_conditions: Do not remove feed baseline option
Do not greenlight nonfeed capability when provider surface is false
Do not import runtime/scheduler in gate
